title: MegaCorp Renewal - Strategic Discount Decision
decision_made: Approved 15% discount + ¥3M value-adds, structured as 3-year deal
rationale_summary: Customer-first approach balanced with financial discipline. Creative value-adds cost less than pure discount. Multi-year commitment reduces churn risk.
lessons_learned: Negotiate value not just price. Know your walk-away point. Speed matters in enterprise deals.

title: AI Features Investment - Phased Approach
decision_made: Approved ¥12M pilot (vs ¥40M full request), prove value before scaling
rationale_summary: Reduce risk with phased approach. CTO convinced with strong business case. Balance innovation with financial discipline.
lessons_learned: Start small, prove value, then scale. Don't bet the farm on unproven tech.

title: Career Development Program Post-VP Departure
decision_made: Launched comprehensive career development program (¥5M annual investment)
rationale_summary: Attrition signal from VP Engineering departure. Systemic fix better than counter-offers. Investment in all employees vs bidding wars.
lessons_learned: People issues require systemic solutions. Career growth is retention strategy. Transparency about challenges builds trust.

title: Strategic Account Pricing Framework
decision_made: Created formal framework for strategic account discounts, based on DC_AKIKO_001
rationale_summary: MegaCorp precedent formalized into repeatable process. Prevents ad-hoc discounting. Clear approval thresholds.
lessons_learned: Good decisions become precedents. Formalize what works into policy.

title: Board Decision - Defer Fundraising
decision_made: Recommended deferring Series C to Q4 2024/Q1 2025, raise from strength
rationale_summary: 18 months runway sufficient. Close to profitability. Better valuation if profitable or clear path visible.
lessons_learned: Timing matters in fundraising. Raise when you don't need money.

title: Sales Team Expansion - Phased Approach
decision_made: Approved 6 AEs (vs 10 requested), phased hiring with performance gates
rationale_summary: Balance growth ambition with financial discipline. Prove productivity with first cohort before expanding further.
lessons_learned: Phased approaches reduce risk. Performance gates ensure accountability.

title: Pricing Strategy - 10-15% Increase
decision_made: Implemented 10-15% price increase for new customers, effective April 1
rationale_summary: Product value increased 35% in 18 months but price unchanged. Market supports higher pricing. Minimal customer pushback.
lessons_learned: Price to value delivered. Test and learn. Customers respect transparency about value.

title: AWS Cost Optimization - Phased Program
decision_made: Approved phased AWS optimization: ¥70M → ¥45M annual run-rate
rationale_summary: Phase 1: Eliminate waste. Phase 2: Rightsizing. Phase 3: Reserved instances. Target ¥37M savings.
lessons_learned: Low-hanging fruit first. Measure impact. Systematic approach to cost optimization.

title: Fundraising Timing Analysis
decision_made: Recommended deferring fundraising 2-3 quarters, supported CEO recommendation
rationale_summary: Financial analysis shows better to raise when profitable. Current runway sufficient. Avoid dilution.
lessons_learned: CFO financial discipline complements CEO strategic vision.

title: Working Capital Management - DSO Reduction
decision_made: Initiated program to reduce DSO from 78 to 45 days, adjusted sales comp
rationale_summary: DSO spike ties up ¥70M in working capital. Payment terms tightening. Sales comp now includes cash collection component.
lessons_learned: Working capital is real capital. Sales incentives drive behavior.

title: Quarterly Security Audits Post-Incident
decision_made: Implemented quarterly penetration testing (vs annual), bug bounty program
rationale_summary: Security incident (DC_YUKI_005) revealed gaps. Quarterly audits catch issues faster. Bug bounty incentivizes external researchers.
lessons_learned: Prevention cheaper than incident response. Security is continuous, not one-time.

title: Intercom vs Zendesk - Customer Support Platform
decision_made: Selected Intercom over Zendesk and Freshdesk for customer support
rationale_summary: Better user experience, modern tech stack, better pricing, migration support. ROI calculation showed 18-month payback.
lessons_learned: Build vs buy framework works. Vendor selection is strategic.

title: Legacy Admin Panel Modernization
decision_made: Prioritized modernizing 6-year-old admin panel after security incident
rationale_summary: SQL injection vulnerability in legacy code. Modernization prevents future incidents. Python 2.7 → Python 3.11 migration.
lessons_learned: Legacy code is security risk. Technical debt has real cost.

title: 6-Week Technical Debt Sprint
decision_made: Approved pausing features for 6 weeks to pay down technical debt
rationale_summary: Velocity declined 40% due to accumulated debt. 6 weeks investment to gain 36% velocity improvement. ROI: 2.3x.
lessons_learned: Technical debt is real debt. Pay it proactively on your terms.

title: Security Incident Response - Radical Transparency
decision_made: Full disclosure within 24 hours, comprehensive security overhaul
rationale_summary: SQL injection breach accessed 15,247 customer records. Transparent communication built trust. Customer churn: 0.02%.
lessons_learned: Transparency in crisis builds trust. Fast response contains damage.

title: Marketing Budget Allocation - 70/30 Split
decision_made: Shifted marketing spend: 70% demand gen, 30% brand (from 85/15)
rationale_summary: Brand awareness correlates with win rates. Long-term investment needed. Balanced approach: short-term pipeline + long-term brand.
lessons_learned: Brand takes time but pays off. Balanced marketing strategy wins.

title: Mid-Market Brand Transformation
decision_made: Repositioned from 'Enterprise-grade' to 'Scales with you', ¥25M investment
rationale_summary: Enterprise-only perception limited growth. Mid-market is 50% of TAM. Website redesign, case studies, transparent pricing.
lessons_learned: Brand perception is reality. Address perception gaps proactively.

title: Marketing-Sales Alignment - SRL Definition
decision_made: Redefined lead quality (MQL → SRL), implemented bi-directional SLAs
rationale_summary: Lead quality was 12% conversion. Sales frustrated. New SRL definition: 38% conversion. Weekly Revenue Team meetings.
lessons_learned: Alignment matters more than volume. Quality over quantity.

title: Content Quality Over Quantity
decision_made: Shifted from 3-4 blog posts/week to 1-2 high-quality posts/week
rationale_summary: Surface-level content wasn't converting. Research reports drive 52% conversion vs 28% for blogs. Time on page +240%.
lessons_learned: One great piece beats 10 mediocre ones. Deep content wins in B2B.

title: Customer Research Investment
decision_made: Invested ¥5M in 'State of B2B Productivity' research report
rationale_summary: 12,400 downloads, 85 SRLs (52% conversion), major thought leadership win. Competitive differentiation through original research.
lessons_learned: Original research is marketing gold. Thought leadership drives pipeline.
